speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning. I understand you are here because of bleeding after menopause and a mass found in the pelvic region. To help me understand this better, can you describe the amount and frequency of the bleeding, and have you experienced any abdominal pain or bloating?

text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits.
